exposure: Temporary ligation of the bilateral uterine arteries during laparoscopy combined with hysteroscopy
outcome: Postoperative complications (decrease in menstrual bleeding, alteration in the menstrual cycle)
cohort: 83 patients who had initially undergone laparoscopy combined with hysteroscopy for caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) between 2012 and 2018
finding: Temporary ligation of the bilateral uterine arteries during laparoscopy combined with hysteroscopy resulted in less intraoperative blood loss than laparoscopy combined with hysteroscopy without ligation, particularly in patients with higher serum β-hCG levels.
